verdict.rationale: Cake's MCP/AI integration is explicitly read-only—querying cap table data (shareholders, vesting, option pool headroom) in plain English—with no evidence of drafting securities, creating option grants programmatically, or queuing them for board approval via an agent. The OpenAPI/API probe also returned 404s, and board approval features (docs-10) are described as human-driven UI flows, not agent-initiated.
